summary: 11/115 is already the sole inherited example. Its Detransitive Part. Pass. mraṣʕo denotes the resultant inlaid state of the church ceiling and floor; no new quotation or sense is needed.
b- introduces the two inlay materials, mosaics and gold. No agent is expressed. Material coding belongs in the valency note, not in a separate construction sense.
The singular-looking predicate and yo occur with a coordinated ceiling-and-floor expression. Preserve the source form rather than correcting agreement from the German plural translation.

The occurrence supports inlaying, the existing sense. The Arabic paving comparison in the inherited etymology does not supply an independently attested Turoyo paving sense. No idiom or light verb is present.

How is the singular-looking mraṣʕo ... yo agreement with the coordinated ceiling and floor to be analysed: agreement with one conjunct or a construction applying to the whole surface? One occurrence does not decide.
